title: The Alignment Curse: Modality Alignment Supercharges Audio Attacks via Text Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2602.02557v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in end-to-end trained omni-models have substantially improved audio capabilities by strengthening text-audio modality alignment. However, whether such alignment inadvertently facilitates the transfer of safety vulnerabilities across modalities remains underexplored. This question is critical as text-based jailbreak attacks are considerably more mature than audio-based ones; if they transfer systematically, current audio safety evaluations may underestimate risks originating from the text modality. In this paper, we introduce the Alignment Curse, a formally characterized and empirically validated principle showing that stronger modality alignment enables more effective transfer of attacks from text to audio, revealing a fundamental tension between capability and safety. translated_title: 对齐诅咒：模态对齐通过文本迁移大幅增强音频攻击
translated_abstract: 端到端训练的全模态模型的最新进展通过强化文本-音频模态对齐，显著提升了音频能力。然而，这种对齐是否会在无意中促进安全漏洞的跨模态迁移，目前仍未得到充分研究。这一问题至关重要，因为基于文本的越狱攻击远比基于音频的攻击成熟；如果这些攻击能够系统性地迁移，当前的音频安全评估可能低估源自文本模态的风险。在本文中，我们提出了“对齐诅咒”，这是一个经过形式化表征和实证验证的原则，表明更强的模态对齐使攻击从文本到音频的迁移更加有效，揭示了能力与安全之间的根本张力。基于这一原则，我们对近期全模态模型（如 Qwen2.5-Omni 等）上的三类攻击进行了全面的黑盒评估……
tldr: 提出并验证了“对齐诅咒”原则——全模态模型中文本-音频模态对齐越强，文本越狱攻击向音频模态的迁移就越有效，揭示了模型能力提升与安全性之间的根本张力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "Alignment Curse," a formally characterized and empirically validated principle showing that stronger text-audio modality alignment enables more effective transfer of text-based jailbreak attacks to the audio modality, revealing a fundamental tension between capability and safety in omni-models.
